You mishear me or something? I was 
saying it *couldn't* roll on its own.

<CLT=cltMIND>I screwed up! 
I need to think it over again! 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Just kiddiiiiing! That'd be such a boring
ending!

Ah-haha! Wicked sense of humor you got
there, Shuichi!

<CLT=cltMIND>I screwed up! 
I need to think it over again! 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

never failed me yet!

If Rantaro moved after he was struck, there
would be a trail of blood leading to his body.

But his body was clearly laying in a pool
of blood...

Even a pig could understand that the body
didn't move, so why can't you, Miu?

W-Well you don't have to be so
fuckin' rude about it...!

I need to think it over again!

<CLT=cltMIND>The shot put ball rolled on top of the 
bookcases, and hit Rantaro on the head...

<CLT=cltMIND>...I need to answer!
For her sake...I can't turn away from the truth!
